category: 🏺 Living Artifact · Hardship Ball & Chain Formula
title: HSBall 솔로 #053 · 글래머아워글래스 · Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted · 돌판 머리 위로 받치기
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her early 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, a faintly defeated look, her eyes lowered and a little glassy, the corners of her mouth turned down just slightly, soft champagne-blonde hair styled in low bun, real living eyes. Long round nails, matte finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Hungarian Kalocsa folk painted motif — a deep black ground with bright red, pink and gold folk-art florals, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense folk-art floral motifs filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The color has dulled and cracked along her ribs, waist and thighs, rubbed bare in thin streaks over her shoulders and the backs of her knees so her skin shows through the worn paint. Soot smears her cheekbones, forehead and jawline, sweat shines on her temples and her makeup is smudged, black dust streaks her forearms, shins and the backs of her hands, and her bare feet are filthy with dust and dirt.

Restraints: She holds a huge rough-cut grey stone slab level above her head in both hands, her arms raised straight up and trembling under its weight. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb, down and outward to its own huge black iron ring set in the flagstone floor on its own side.

Pose: standing full height, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up holding the stone slab level above her head, her elbows trembling, her head tilted slightly back under the weight, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body straining, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
